description: This file defines the UriNormalizer class which provides methods for normalizing and comparing URIs, including functionalities such as percent-encoding normalization, decoding unreserved characters, converting empty paths, removing default ports/hosts, and sorting query parameters.

classes.name: UriNormalizer
classes.description: A final class providing static methods to normalize and compare URIs based on various standard and custom normalization rules.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Returns a normalized URI applying selected normalization rules such as percent-encoding, unreserved characters decoding, empty path conversion, default host/port removal, dot segments removal, slash consolidation, and query parameter sorting.

methods.name: isEquivalent
methods.description: Checks whether two URIs are equivalent after applying specified normalization rules, enabling comparison of URIs considering normalization effects.
